Our Story & Philosophy

Shadow, Warmth & Single-Estate Terroir

“We built NOIRE as a quiet counterpoint to hurried city mornings — a room where every cup honors both the farmer’s shade canopy and the baker’s dawn fermentation.”
— Kabir & Meera Vance, Founders of NOIRE

Each morning before dawn, our pastry kitchen laminates cultured noisette butter into stone-milled organic flour while our roasters cup single-estate harvests from high-elevation farms across Karnataka, Odisha, and Kyoto.

Served in hand-thrown matte black stoneware across smoked oak tables, every beverage is designed to be experienced slowly.

Direct Estate Sourcing

100% traceable microlots harvested at peak ripeness from partner estates in Chikmagalur, Ratnagiri, and Koraput.

Cast-Iron Drum Roasting

Roasted in small batches to preserve delicate jasmine, roasted hazelnut, and dark cacao aromatics.

Artisanal Boulangerie

36-hour cold-fermented country sourdough and French viennoiserie baked fresh throughout the morning.

Unhurried Hospitality

Thoughtful acoustics, warm architectural lighting, and attentive table service designed for unhurried conversation.
